svg.content: <mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="platform-pipeline" name="Platform CI/CD pipeline and release model"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="3200" pageHeight="1850" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=30;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#102a43;" value="Platform CI/CD Pipeline and Release Model | Aroma Pacifico" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="45" width="3120" x="40" y="25" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="subtitle" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=17;fontColor=#334e68;" value="Repositories, pipeline identity, plan-only gates, environment promotion (dev -&gt; qa -&gt; pdn), release candidates, CodeDeploy traffic shift, and rollback hooks. ADR-003, ASM-170 to ASM-179." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="35" width="3120" x="40" y="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_repos" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f8fc;strokeColor=#61788d;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=18;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=15;" value="SOURCE REPOSITORIES | triggering paths (A18 sec 3.1)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1055" width="560" x="40" y="125" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="repo_modules" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">Public Modules Repository</font></b><br/><font color="#0b69a3"><b>aroma-pacifico-terraform-modules</b></font><br/><br/><b>Trigger path:</b> <code>modules/&lt;name&gt;/**</code><br/><b>Produces:</b> SemVer git tags (<code>?ref=vX.Y.Z</code>)<br/><br/><b>Module CI verification gates:</b><br/>• <code>terraform fmt -check -recursive</code><br/>• <code>terraform validate</code> &amp; <code>tflint</code><br/>• Trivy / Checkov security scanner<br/>• <code>terraform test</code> with mock providers<br/><br/><i>Zero cloud credentials or account IDs (ADR-003)</i>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="270" width="510" x="65" y="180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="repo_infra" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">Private Infrastructure Repository</font></b><br/><font color="#0b69a3"><b>aroma-pacifico-infrastructure</b></font><br/><br/><b>Trigger paths:</b><br/>• <code>stacks/network/**</code>, <code>stacks/security/**</code><br/>• <code>stacks/state-backend/**</code>, <code>stacks/workload/**</code><br/>• <code>stacks/workload/releases.tfvars</code> (ASM-171)<br/><br/><b>Infrastructure PR gates:</b><br/>• All module gates + secret scanning<br/>• Digest existence verified across all 3 artifact buckets<br/>• <code>terraform plan</code> for dev, qa, pdn attached to PR<br/>• Destroys and replacements highlighted first<br/><br/><b>Produces:</b> Saved plans per environment (ADR-003)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="310" width="510" x="65" y="475" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="badge_D01" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dcebf7;strokeColor=#52708a;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="D01" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="55" x="505" y="485" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="repo_platform" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">Future Application Repository</font></b><br/><font color="#0b69a3"><b>aroma-pacifico-platform (ASM-170, PD-170)</b></font><br/><br/><b>Trigger paths:</b><br/>• Platform: <code>services/api/**</code>, <code>functions/**</code>, <code>web/**</code><br/>• Ingestion: <code>functions/threshold/**</code>, <code>functions/notification-dispatcher/**</code><br/>• Drone reception: <code>functions/reception/**</code>, <code>inference/prompts/**</code><br/><br/><b>Platform PR gates:</b><br/>• Unit tests, lint, vulnerability &amp; secret scanning<br/>• Contract tests against current &amp; previous schemas (ASM-175)<br/><br/><b>Release tag push:</b> Rebuild, SHA-256 digest, SBOM" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="340" width="510" x="65" y="810" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_identity" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f8fc;strokeColor=#61788d;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=18;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=15;" value="PIPELINE IDENTITY & SECURITY | ADR-003" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1055" width="500" x="630" y="125" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="oidc_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">GitHub Actions OIDC Provider</font></b><br/><code>token.actions.githubusercontent.com</code><br/><br/>• Zero long-term IAM users or static keys (A08 SCP)<br/>• Short-lived AWS STS credentials via AssumeRole<br/>• Audience: <code>sts.amazonaws.com</code><br/>• Strict subject validation bound to repository &amp; environment" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="170" width="450" x="655" y="180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="roles_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">Three Dedicated OIDC Roles (A18 sec 3.3)</font></b><br/><br/><b>1. Plan Role (ADR-003):</b><br/>• Subject: PR &amp; main tokens of infrastructure repo<br/>• Rights: Read state, acquire lock (<code>*.tflock</code>), read-only describe<br/><br/><b>2. Apply Role (ADR-003):</b><br/>• Subject: Deployment environments (<code>dev</code>, <code>qa</code>, <code>pdn</code>)<br/>• Rights: Apply saved plan, execute CodeDeploy deployments<br/><br/><b>3. Artifact Publisher Role (ASM-171):</b><br/>• Subject: Release tag pushes of platform repo<br/>• Rights: <code>s3:PutObject</code> on <code>artifacts/*</code> in artifact buckets<br/>• Zero rights to read data, manage Lambda, or run CodeDeploy" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="305" width="450" x="655" y="375" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="state_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">Remote State Backend (ADR-003)</font></b><br/><br/>• Dedicated S3 state bucket per environment (dev, qa, pdn)<br/>• Native S3 locking (<code>*.tflock</code>) - zero DynamoDB lock table<br/>• KMS customer-managed key (<code>state</code> key)<br/>• S3 Object Versioning + deletion protection (<code>prevent_destroy</code>)<br/>• Saved plans never committed; short retention in GitHub Actions" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="190" width="450" x="655" y="705" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="badge_D02" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dcebf7;strokeColor=#52708a;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="D02" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="55" x="1035" y="715" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="secrets_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">Secrets Management (A18 sec 11)</font></b><br/><br/>• Secrets kept out of repository and out of state<br/>• AWS Secrets Manager &amp; SSM Parameter Store (SecureString)<br/>• Ephemeral resources into write-only arguments<br/>• Lambda roles fetch secrets at runtime (never stored in env vars)<br/>• Transversal tags: <code>common_tags</code> &amp; <code>CostCenter</code> (ASM-064)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="230" width="450" x="655" y="920" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="badge_D03" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dcebf7;strokeColor=#52708a;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="D03" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="55" x="1035" y="930" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_model" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f8fc;strokeColor=#61788d;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=18;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=15;" value="COMMON RELEASE MODEL | promotion (ASM-171)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1055" width="520" x="1160" y="125" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rc_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">Release Candidate (RC) Definition</font></b><br/><br/>• Exactly 1 merge commit SHA on <code>main</code> of infrastructure repo<br/>• Pins everything that reaches an environment:<br/> - Module source tags: <code>?ref=vX.Y.Z</code> (PC-IAC-015)<br/> - <code>stacks/workload/releases.tfvars</code>: semver &amp; SHA-256 digests<br/>• Promotion by construction: Same commit is planned &amp; applied in<br/> <code>dev</code> -&gt; <code>qa</code> -&gt; <code>pdn</code>. Environments cannot run unverified digests." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="240" width="470" x="1185" y="180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="artifact_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">Immutable Artifact Staging</font></b><br/><br/>• Artifact S3 Bucket per environment (<code>aroma-&lt;env&gt;-artifacts</code>):<br/> - Path: <code>artifacts/functions/&lt;fn&gt;/&lt;semver&gt;/&lt;sha256&gt;.zip</code><br/> - Staged once on release tag; identical bytes in dev, qa, pdn<br/><br/>• Static Assets S3 Bucket (reports web, lookup page):<br/> - Unpacked to <code>releases/&lt;semver&gt;/</code> with versioned file names<br/> - Active bundle switched by CloudFront origin path in tfvars<br/> - Zero cache invalidation needed on switch or rollback (ASM-176)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="260" width="470" x="1185" y="445" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="codedeploy_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">Function Deployment Pattern (A18 sec 4.3)</font></b><br/><br/>• Terraform publishes version: <code>publish = true</code>, <code>source_code_hash</code><br/>• Terraform declares <code>live</code> alias &amp; CodeDeploy deployment group<br/>• Event sources target <code>live</code> alias ARN, never <code>$LATEST</code><br/>• Pre-traffic check: <code>CodeSha256</code> verified against <code>releases.tfvars</code><br/>• External agent rule: Alias carries lifecycle rule:<br/> <code>ignore_changes = [function_version, routing_config]</code><br/> (Permitted by PC-IAC-010 sec 3.2 for external agents)<br/>• CodeDeploy moves <code>live</code> alias and triggers automatic rollback" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="420" width="470" x="1185" y="730" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_stages" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f8fc;strokeColor=#61788d;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=18;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=15;" value="CONTROLLED PROMOTION | dev -&gt; qa -&gt; pdn stages, gates and approval (A18 sec 4, ADR-003)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1055" width="1450" x="1710" y="125" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="stage_dev" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">DEVELOPMENT (dev)</font></b><br/><b>Account:</b> Development (10.80.0.0/16) | NonProduction OU<br/><br/><b>Purpose:</b> Continuous integration of every merge to main<br/><b>Trigger:</b> Merge commit on <code>main</code> of infra repo<br/><b>GitHub Environment:</b> <code>dev</code> (no reviewer required)<br/><br/><b>Execution steps:</b><br/>1. Plan dev stack using OIDC plan role<br/>2. Apply saved plan using OIDC apply role<br/>3. Function deployment: CodeDeploy <code>LambdaAllAtOnce</code><br/><br/><b>Error handling &amp; Logs:</b><br/>• Failures are fixed forward (no rollback needed in dev)<br/>• Local development logs (not archived to audit, ASM-068)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="970" width="430" x="1735" y="180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="stage_qa" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">TEST &amp; ACCEPTANCE (qa)</font></b><br/><b>Account:</b> Test (10.81.0.0/16) | NonProduction OU<br/><br/><b>Purpose:</b> Formal acceptance testing before production<br/><b>Pattern environment:</b> The ONLY plan Epic 6 evaluates (ASM-051)<br/><br/><b>Gate &amp; Approval:</b><br/>• Prerequisite: <code>dev</code> stage succeeded for exact same commit SHA<br/>• <b>Approval:</b> 1 reviewer of SR1, SR2, JR1, JR2 (other than author)<br/><br/><b>Execution steps:</b><br/>1. Apply saved <code>qa</code> plan using apply role<br/>2. CodeDeploy: <code>LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes</code><br/> (Exercised in qa to validate canary &amp; rollback, ASM-174)<br/><br/><b>Acceptance Suite (ASM-177):</b><br/>• API contract tests for current &amp; previous event schemas<br/>• Sack lifecycle replay through all states of A16 sec 3<br/>• Sack lookup by code verifying only buyer-view fields (ASM-096)<br/>• Sign-in with MFA for <code>staff</code> test identity<br/>• Synthetic telemetry publication through real endpoint<br/>• Recorded drone sample mission upload with upload grant<br/><br/><b>Result:</b> Formally recorded in GitHub deployment status" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="970" width="460" x="2195" y="180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="stage_pdn" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">PRODUCTION (pdn)</font></b><br/><b>Account:</b> Production (10.82.0.0/16) | Production OU<br/><b>Policy:</b> Changes strictly through pipeline (A08 SCP)<br/><br/><br/><b>Four Production Gates (evaluated cheapest first):</b><br/>1. <b>QA Acceptance:</b> Succeeded for exact same commit SHA<br/>2. <b>Release Note &amp; Notice:</b> Completed note &amp; notice sent to<br/> Federation &gt;= 2 business days before window (ASM-173, Q-15)<br/>3. <b>Harvest-Week Window Check:</b><br/> • Blocked 05:00 - 18:00 Colombia time on harvest days in<br/> Cauca, Huila or Tolima (ASM-007, ASM-055)<br/> • Expected end (apply + canaries + bake) must be &lt; 05:00 (ASM-178)<br/> • Incident exception only with <code>INC-YYYYMMDD-NN</code> (ASM-183)<br/>4. <b>Required Reviewers:</b> One of SR1 or SR2, other than author<br/> and other than person who triggered the run (ASM-172)<br/><br/><b>Execution steps:</b><br/>1. Apply saved <code>pdn</code> plan using apply role<br/>2. CodeDeploy: <code>LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes</code><br/><br/><b>Automatic Rollback on CloudWatch Alarm Set:</b><br/>• Function errors, throttles, DLQ message age, API Gateway 5XX<br/>• Target rollback time: &lt; 10 minutes to previous version" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="970" width="450" x="2685" y="180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="badge_D11" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dcebf7;strokeColor=#52708a;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="D11" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="52" x="2955" y="190" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="badge_D12" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dcebf7;strokeColor=#52708a;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="D12" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="52" x="3015" y="190" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="badge_D13" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dcebf7;strokeColor=#52708a;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="D13" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="52" x="3075" y="190" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_rollback" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f8fc;strokeColor=#61788d;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=18;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=15;" value="ROLLBACK MECHANISMS & RECOVERY TARGETS | A18 sec 10, ASM-174" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="610" width="1000" x="40" y="1205" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rb_mechs" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">Four Rollback Mechanisms</font></b><br/><br/><b>1. CodeDeploy Automatic Rollback:</b><br/>• Trigger: CloudWatch alarm during canary shift or bake period<br/>• Target time: Traffic returned to previous version &lt; 10 minutes<br/><br/><b>2. Rollback Deployment:</b><br/>• Trigger: Post-deployment defect detected by operators or auditors<br/>• Action: Approver moves alias to recorded previous version (keeps &gt;= 5 versions)<br/>• Target time: Within 30 minutes of decision<br/><br/><b>3. Revert Commit through Promotion:</b><br/>• Used for: Module tags, topic rules, bucket policies, WAF, routing<br/>• Action: Git revert commit promoted dev -&gt; qa -&gt; pdn with review &amp; approval<br/>• Target time: Within 2 hours of decision (inside 4-hour lookup RTO, ASM-157)<br/><br/><b>4. Dead-Letter Queue Redrive:</b><br/>• Used for: Events that failed while defective version was active<br/>• Action: Platform operator redrives messages from DLQ after rollback" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="530" width="460" x="65" y="1260" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rb_unrollbackable" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">Forward Correction Model (What Cannot Be Rolled Back)</font></b><br/><br/>• <b>Sack events already written:</b><br/> - <code>sack_event_log</code> is immutable (conditional puts only; no update/delete)<br/> - <i>'Un despliegue no pierde eventos de saco'</i> holds across all rollbacks<br/> - Defective events corrected via compensating events (ASM-151)<br/> - Derived tables rebuilt from log by sack applier (A16 sec 9.2)<br/><br/>• <b>Stored telemetry readings with wrong attributes:</b><br/> - IoT Core keeps no raw copy post-rule execution<br/> - Corrected by audited batch correction job or marked unreliable<br/><br/>• <b>Alerts and notifications already sent to farmers:</b><br/> - SMS / push already delivered cannot be revoked<br/> - Correction notice dispatched over same channels<br/><br/>• <b>Inference results and activated polygon versions:</b><br/> - Results superseded by newer result with <code>function_version</code> (ASM-175)<br/> - Previous polygon version activated as a new version<br/><br/>• <b>Quarantined / restricted objects:</b> Restored from versioned S3 under incident" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="530" width="465" x="550" y="1260" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_relnotes" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f8fc;strokeColor=#61788d;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=18;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=15;" value="RELEASE NOTES & FEDERATION NOTICE | A22 (ASM-180 to ASM-185)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="610" width="1010" x="1070" y="1205" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rn_templates" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">Two Standardized Release Notes Templates</font></b><br/><br/><b>1. Application Template (template-application.md):</b><br/>• User-visible changes: sack lookup, reports web, alert content or channel,<br/> inference outcomes, mobile API behavior<br/><br/><b>2. Infrastructure Template (template-infrastructure.md):</b><br/>• Network, firewall rules, ingestion topic rules, drone path S3 bucket/routing,<br/> center firewall device configuration (ASM-184)<br/><br/><b>Common Eight Sections Across Both Templates:</b><br/>1. Change ('qué cambia'): Component, boxes D01-D13, commits, digests<br/>2. Window ('la ventana'): Colombia time, harvest check, expected end &lt; 05:00<br/>3. Impact ('el impacto'): Producers, centers, transporters, buyers, Federation<br/>4. Approval ('la aprobación'): Approver roles by stage (SR1, SR2, JR1, JR2)<br/>5. Notice ('el aviso a la Federación'): Recipient, channel, lead time met<br/>6. Rollback ('cómo se vuelve atrás'): Mechanism, trigger, target time, target<br/>7. Verification: Post-release checks and observations<br/>8. Incident Exception ('salvo incidente'): INC reference, declaring role" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="530" width="465" x="1095" y="1260" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rn_notice" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8da2b5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="<b><font size="4" color="#102a43">Federation Notice &amp; Observability Hooks</font></b><br/><br/>• <b>Notice Protocol (ASM-173, Q-15):</b><br/> - Standard change: Notice dispatched &gt;= 2 business days before window<br/> - Incident change: Notice dispatched at decision time before apply<br/> - Missing window: Rescheduled with full notice lead time (ASM-182)<br/> - Mandatory fields checked by pipeline job before pdn run<br/><br/>• <b>Observability Hooks (A18 sec 12, A21):</b><br/> - Deployment event published as GitHub deployment status and<br/> dispatched to pdn release SNS topic<br/> - CodeDeploy event triggers (start, success, fail, rollback) notify topic<br/> - Rollback alarm set: Errors, throttles, DLQ age, API Gateway 5XX<br/><br/>• <b>Governance Rules:</b><br/> - Threshold changes are Federation data (not deployments, no note needed)<br/> - Completed note committed within 1 business day of release (ASM-180)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="530" width="470" x="1585" y="1260" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_boundary" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f8fc;strokeColor=#61788d;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#172b4d;fontSize=18;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=15;" value="PLAN-ONLY aroma-pacifico-terraform-modules

• terraform test with mock providers
Zero cloud credentials or account IDs (ADR-003)

GitHub Actions OIDC Provider
token.actions.githubusercontent.com
• Zero long-term IAM users or static keys (A08 SCP)
• Short-lived AWS STS credentials via AssumeRole
• Audience: sts.amazonaws.com
• Strict subject validation bound to repository & environment

div.div:
Three Dedicated OIDC Roles (A18 sec 3.3)
1. Plan Role (ADR-003):
• Subject: PR & main tokens of infrastructure repo
• Rights: Read state, acquire lock (*.tflock), read-only describe
2. Apply Role (ADR-003):
• Subject: Deployment environments (dev, qa, pdn)
• Rights: Apply saved plan, execute CodeDeploy deployments
3. Artifact Publisher Role (ASM-171):
• Subject: Release tag pushes of platform repo
• Rights: s3:PutObject on artifacts/* in artifact buckets
• Zero rights to read data, manage Lambda, or run CodeDeploy

div.div:
Remote State Backend (ADR-003)
• Dedicated S3 state bucket per environment (dev, qa, pdn)
• Native S3 locking (*.tflock) - zero DynamoDB lock table
• KMS customer-managed key (state key)
• S3 Object Versioning + deletion protection (prevent_destroy)
• Saved plans never committed; short retention in GitHub Actions

div.div:
Secrets Management (A18 sec 11)
• Secrets kept out of repository and out of state
• AWS Secrets Manager & SSM Parameter Store (SecureString)
• Ephemeral resources into write-only arguments
• Lambda roles fetch secrets at runtime (never stored in env vars)
• Transversal tags: common_tags & CostCenter (ASM-064)

div.div:
Release Candidate (RC) Definition
• Exactly 1 merge commit SHA on main of infrastructure repo
• Pins everything that reaches an environment:
- Module source tags: ?ref=vX.Y.Z (PC-IAC-015)
- stacks/workload/releases.tfvars: semver & SHA-256 digests
• Promotion by construction: Same commit is planned & applied in
dev -> qa -> pdn. Environments cannot run unverified digests.

div.div:
Immutable Artifact Staging
• Artifact S3 Bucket per environment (aroma-<env>-artifacts):
- Path: artifacts/functions/<fn>/<semver>/<sha256>.zip
- Staged once on release tag; identical bytes in dev, qa, pdn
• Static Assets S3 Bucket (reports web, lookup page):
- Unpacked to releases/<semver>/ with versioned file names
- Active bundle switched by CloudFront origin path in tfvars
- Zero cache invalidation needed on switch or rollback (ASM-176)

div.div:
Function Deployment Pattern (A18 sec 4.3)
• Terraform publishes version: publish = true, source_code_hash
• Terraform declares live alias & CodeDeploy deployment group
• Event sources target live alias ARN, never $LATEST
• Pre-traffic check: CodeSha256 verified against releases.tfvars
• External agent rule: Alias carries lifecycle rule:
ignore_changes = [function_version, routing_config]
(Permitted by PC-IAC-010 sec 3.2 for external agents)
• CodeDeploy moves live alias and triggers automatic rollback

div.div:
DEVELOPMENT (dev)
Account: Development (10.80.0.0/16) | NonProduction OU
Purpose: Continuous integration of every merge to main
Trigger: Merge commit on main of infra repo
GitHub Environment: dev (no reviewer required)
Execution steps:
1. Plan dev stack using OIDC plan role
2. Apply saved plan using OIDC apply role
3. Function deployment: CodeDeploy LambdaAllAtOnce
Error handling & Logs:
• Failures are fixed forward (no rollback needed in dev)
• Local development logs (not archived to audit, ASM-068)

div.div:
TEST & ACCEPTANCE (qa)
Account: Test (10.81.0.0/16) | NonProduction OU
Purpose: Formal acceptance testing before production
Pattern environment: The ONLY plan Epic 6 evaluates (ASM-051)
Gate & Approval:
• Prerequisite: dev stage succeeded for exact same commit SHA
• Approval: 1 reviewer of SR1, SR2, JR1, JR2 (other than author)
Execution steps:
1. Apply saved qa plan using apply role
2. CodeDeploy: LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes
(Exercised in qa to validate canary & rollback, ASM-174)
Acceptance Suite (ASM-177):
• API contract tests for current & previous event schemas
• Sack lifecycle replay through all states of A16 sec 3
• Sack lookup by code verifying only buyer-view fields (ASM-096)
• Sign-in with MFA for staff test identity
• Synthetic telemetry publication through real endpoint
• Recorded drone sample mission upload with upload grant
Result: Formally recorded in GitHub deployment status

div.div:
PRODUCTION (pdn)
Account: Production (10.82.0.0/16) | Production OU
Policy: Changes strictly through pipeline (A08 SCP)
Four Production Gates (evaluated cheapest first):
1. QA Acceptance: Succeeded for exact same commit SHA
2. Release Note & Notice: Completed note & notice sent to
Federation >= 2 business days before window (ASM-173, Q-15)
3. Harvest-Week Window Check:
• Blocked 05:00 - 18:00 Colombia time on harvest days in
Cauca, Huila or Tolima (ASM-007, ASM-055)
• Expected end (apply + canaries + bake) must be < 05:00 (ASM-178)
• Incident exception only with INC-YYYYMMDD-NN (ASM-183)
4. Required Reviewers: One of SR1 or SR2, other than author
and other than person who triggered the run (ASM-172)
Execution steps:
1. Apply saved pdn plan using apply role
2. CodeDeploy: LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes
Automatic Rollback on CloudWatch Alarm Set:
• Function errors, throttles, DLQ message age, API Gateway 5XX
• Target rollback time: < 10 minutes to previous version

div.div: ROLLBACK MECHANISMS & RECOVERY TARGETS | A18 sec 10, ASM-174

div.div:
Four Rollback Mechanisms
1. CodeDeploy Automatic Rollback:
• Trigger: CloudWatch alarm during canary shift or bake period
• Target time: Traffic returned to previous version < 10 minutes
2. Rollback Deployment:
• Trigger: Post-deployment defect detected by operators or auditors
• Action: Approver moves alias to recorded previous version (keeps >= 5 versions)
• Target time: Within 30 minutes of decision
3. Revert Commit through Promotion:
• Used for: Module tags, topic rules, bucket policies, WAF, routing
• Action: Git revert commit promoted dev -> qa -> pdn with review & approval
• Target time: Within 2 hours of decision (inside 4-hour lookup RTO, ASM-157)
4. Dead-Letter Queue Redrive:
• Used for: Events that failed while defective version was active
• Action: Platform operator redrives messages from DLQ after rollback

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(141, 162, 181), rgb(85, 103, 120));

div.div:
Forward Correction Model (What Cannot Be Rolled Back)
• Sack events already written:
- sack_event_log is immutable (conditional puts only; no update/delete)
- 'Un despliegue no pierde eventos de saco' holds across all rollbacks
- Defective events corrected via compensating events (ASM-151)
- Derived tables rebuilt from log by sack applier (A16 sec 9.2)
• Stored telemetry readings with wrong attributes:
- IoT Core keeps no raw copy post-rule execution
- Corrected by audited batch correction job or marked unreliable
• Alerts and notifications already sent to farmers:
- SMS / push already delivered cannot be revoked
- Correction notice dispatched over same channels
• Inference results and activated polygon versions:
- Results superseded by newer result with function_version (ASM-175)
- Previous polygon version activated as a new version
• Quarantined / restricted objects: Restored from versioned S3 under incident

div.div:
Two Standardized Release Notes Templates
1. Application Template (template-application.md):
• User-visible changes: sack lookup, reports web, alert content or channel,
inference outcomes, mobile API behavior
2. Infrastructure Template (template-infrastructure.md):
• Network, firewall rules, ingestion topic rules, drone path S3 bucket/routing,
center firewall device configuration (ASM-184)
Common Eight Sections Across Both Templates:
1. Change ('qué cambia'): Component, boxes D01-D13, commits, digests
2. Window ('la ventana'): Colombia time, harvest check, expected end < 05:00
3. Impact ('el impacto'): Producers, centers, transporters, buyers, Federation
4. Approval ('la aprobación'): Approver roles by stage (SR1, SR2, JR1, JR2)
5. Notice ('el aviso a la Federación'): Recipient, channel, lead time met
6. Rollback ('cómo se vuelve atrás'): Mechanism, trigger, target time, target
7. Verification: Post-release checks and observations
8. Incident Exception ('salvo incidente'): INC reference, declaring role

div.div:
Federation Notice & Observability Hooks
• Notice Protocol (ASM-173, Q-15):
- Standard change: Notice dispatched >= 2 business days before window
- Incident change: Notice dispatched at decision time before apply
- Missing window: Rescheduled with full notice lead time (ASM-182)
- Mandatory fields checked by pipeline job before pdn run
• Observability Hooks (A18 sec 12, A21):
- Deployment event published as GitHub deployment status and
dispatched to pdn release SNS topic
- CodeDeploy event triggers (start, success, fail, rollback) notify topic
- Rollback alarm set: Errors, throttles, DLQ age, API Gateway 5XX
• Governance Rules:
- Threshold changes are Federation data (not deployments, no note needed)
- Completed note committed within 1 business day of release (ASM-180)

div.div: PLAN-ONLY BOUNDARY & IAC TRACEABILITY | Academic DevOps Challenge

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(141, 162, 181), rgb(85, 103, 120));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 978px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1262px; margin-left: 2118px;

div.div:
Contractual Plan-Only Mandate (AGENTS.md, ADR-003, B13)
• Plan-only rule: Never run terraform apply, never deploy, never create cloud resources.
• The academic challenge evaluates plan files, architectures, and design contracts.
• Every deployment step is specified, designed and verified without executing in the cloud.
• The executable plan of Epic 6 is evaluated exclusively on qa (ASM-051).
• The 100-hour plan (A20) allocates owners, order and verification to boxes D01-D13.
Traceability to IaC Diagram Boxes (Architecture Section 14):
• D01: aroma-pacifico-infrastructure root stacks consuming module tags (B01)
• D02: One natively locked S3 state bucket per environment (B02)
• D03: Per-environment configuration & secrets out of repo and state (B03)
• D11: CI pipeline producing an executable, reviewable plan (B11)
• D12: CD pipeline with pdn approval and harvest-week window (B12)
• D13: Final validation and evidence of the executable plan (B13)
Strict Verification Gates Required on Every Run:
• terraform fmt -check -recursive & terraform validate
• tflint --recursive & Trivy / Checkov security scanning
• Saved plan files attached to PRs with destroys and replacements listed first
